entries.speaker: Preventing Enemy Escape
entries.en: When a panicked enemy attempts to run, you [n]can request assistance from the Thieves Guild [n]to prevent their escape.

entries.speaker: Preventing Enemy Escape
entries.en: However, you can only request help a certain[n]number of times during any given Metaverse[n]infiltration. These will replenish when the[n]date changes.
